about_the_game:
This is a gaming assistant tool designed for gamers who love danmaku culture. Its features include:

  • Danmaku Notifications
    While you’re gaming in full screen, Windows notifications will fly across your screen as danmaku — just like comments on your favorite streaming videos — so you never miss a message without leaving the game.

  • Performance Monitor
    Keep an eye on your PC’s hardware status (CPU, GPU, RAM, etc.) in real-time while you play.

  • Quick Chat Phrases
    Set up custom shortcut phrases to communicate instantly in-game — perfect for team coordination

  • Key Remapping(Tested with several games — some work, some don’t. Occasionally, the software’s approach may be detected as cheating/hacking tools by anti-cheat systems.)
    Customize your key bindings to unify controls across different games — one layout to rule them all!
